WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o.timespan,
         AVG(1.0 * f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS fee_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
kept AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(fee_count) OVER () AS cross_group_avg_count
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio),
       SUM(fee_count),
       AVG(fee_count - cross_group_avg_count)
FROM kept
WHERE fee_count > cross_group_avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: A zero feerate makes the ratio undefined, so NULLIF excludes that ratio from its average; missing rates are ignored by AVG as requested.
